If this is is the case send me an email with your US address and paypal email address and I will send you a money request through paypal - No need to send me an email that you have paid for the order. We check the account daily and would like to keep the emails to a minimum. - We will forward tracking as soon as we process your order. Any questions relating to this order please send an email to me "DutchOrange" on the BGG email system. Please do not call the store in Clermont. You can also email me at paul@pbmexpressusa.com.
